name: Beetroot

moderate.description: Half cup becomes moderate in oligos

siboNotes: Fresh beetroot has a very small safe serving (about 2 slices). However, CANNED beetroot has a larger safe serving of about 60g due to processing reducing FODMAP content. Pickled beets are also generally safer.
preparationTips: Canned or pickled beetroot is better tolerated
Fresh beets should be limited to 2 slices
Check canned products for added onion/garlic
